title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Langport Up to £32,000 Full Time

Butler Rose is delighted to be exclusively partnering with a well-established and successful Somerset-based business to recruit a Finance Assistant to join their finance team in Langport. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a long-term career in finance within a supportive environment that offers exposure across multiple areas of the accounts function. The employer is also happy to support CIMA studies for the right candidate.

The Role

Reporting directly to the Financial Controller, you'll play a key role within a close-knit finance team and gain experience across a broad range of financial responsibilities.

Key duties will include:
- Maintaining accurate sales and purchase ledger records
- Processing customer invoices and supplier transactions
- Reconciling ledger accounts and resolving discrepancies
- Assisting with payroll processing and employee records
- Supporting weekly and monthly management accounts preparation
- Assisting with financial reporting, forecasting and audit requirements
- Preparing and checking export documentation
- Liaising with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders
- Providing general support across the finance function as required

About You

Applicants will ideally have:
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant or similar finance role
- Knowledge of sales ledger, purchase ledger and general accounting processes
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Good Excel and systems skills
- Excellent communication skills
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Knowledge of payroll processes or accounting qualifications would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £32,000
- Full-time permanent position
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm
- Office-based role in Langport
- Support towards CIMA studies
- Opportunity to gain exposure across multiple areas of finance
- Stable, supportive and collaborative team environment

This is an exclusive assignment being managed by Butler Rose. To be considered, please apply today or contact Butler Rose for a confidential discussion.

Butler Rose is committed to equality in the workplace and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Butler Rose is committed to equality in the workplace and is an equal opportunity employer.
Butler Rose Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Weston-super-Mare - £26,000 - £29,000

If you're looking to build on your accountancy experience and broaden your exposure across accounts, tax and client work, this could be an excellent opportunity to take the next step.

Trial Balance are delighted to be working with a respected accountancy practice who are looking to recruit an Accounts Assistant to join its team in Weston-super-Mare. This is a varied role offering the opportunity to work with a diverse portfolio of clients, develop your technical skills and gain valuable experience across a broad range of accounting and taxation work.

As Accounts Assistant, your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing financial statements for limited companies, partnerships and sole traders
- Assisting with personal and corporate tax
- Providing bookkeeping and management accounting support across a varied client portfolio
- Preparing and submitting quarterly VAT returns
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date accounting records for clients
- Responding to day-to-day client queries and developing strong working relationships
- Supporting Partners, Managers and colleagues with wider accounting tasks and ad-hoc projects

The successful Accounts Assistant will:

Have previous experience within an accountancy practice and a good grounding across accounts preparation, bookkeeping and tax.

AAT qualification or equivalent experience would be advantageous, although candidates who are building their experience within practice will also be considered. You'll be organised, accurate and confident communicating with clients and colleagues, with a positive attitude towards learning and development. The ability to manage your own workload, meet deadlines and work effectively as part of a team will also be important.

This is an excellent opportunity for an Accounts Assistant who wants to develop within accountancy practice and gain broader experience than you might expect from a traditional junior accounts role. You'll enjoy regular client contact, varied technical work and the support of an experienced team.

To discuss this Accounts Assistant opportunity in more detail, please contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith quoting reference JVS11302, or submit your application today.

Trial Balance is a market leading supplier of recruitment services to accountancy practices across the South-West and works on vacancies at all levels in a practice environment. For a confidential discussion about your career options please contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith, our dedicated practice specialist.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Job Title: Payroll Assistant

Location: Yeovil, Somerset

Salary: £28,000 - £31,000 PA DOE

Hours: 30-37.5 hours, Monday to Friday flexible dependant on the candidate. The company also offers flexi time with 10-4 being the core hours

Benefits: 25 days plus Bank Holidays, Xmas Closure, Free Parking, Death in Service, Cycle to Work Scheme, Staff Socials, Modern Offices

Are you experienced in payroll looking for your next opportunity within a friendly and professional business? We're working with a well-established and growing accountancy practice in Yeovil who are looking to add a detail-focused payroll professional to their team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys managing payroll processes, building strong client relationships, and working in a supportive environment where accuracy and customer service are highly valued. They are always developing their staff and will fully support you with further qualifications and achieving your CIPP Level 3

The Role

As a Payroll Assistant, you'll be responsible for managing a portfolio of payroll clients and ensuring payrolls are processed accurately and on time. You'll work closely with clients, HMRC, and pension providers while ensuring all statutory deadlines are consistently met.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls for a variety of clients
- Setting up new payroll clients and HMRC accounts
- Processing starters, leavers and payroll amendments
- Submitting RTI reports to HMRC
- Issuing employee payslips and payroll summaries to clients
- Managing auto-enrolment pension submissions and reconciliations
- Calculating and reconciling PAYE payments and Attachment of Earnings Orders
- Liaising with pension providers regarding client schemes
- Responding to payroll-related queries from clients and HMRC
- Ensuring compliance with payroll legislation and filing deadlines
- Supporting colleagues across the wider team as required
- Assisting with administrative duties, system updates and general office support
- Providing clients with up-to-date information on payroll legislation changes

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll ideally have:
- Previous payroll administration experience
- Strong understanding of payroll legislation and compliance requirements
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Confident communication skills and a professional telephone manner
- Ability to manage multiple deadlines and prioritise workloads effectively
- Strong IT skills and experience using payroll software
- A proactive approach and willingness to support the wider team

If you're an organised and reliable payroll professional looking for a new challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Legal Assistant - Family Law

Key Skills & Experience
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Excellent communication skills and a calm, professional manner.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
- Good attention to detail and willingness to learn.
- Confidence using MS Office and legal case-management systems.
- Prior legal office experience is helpful but not essential.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are on the hunt for adynamic and friendly individual to be the first point of contact for our patients and medical professionals. If you're an organised multitasker with a passion for helping people, this is the perfect role for you! We have two posts available which will require flexibility within working hours as well as location across our three surgeries at St Chads, Somerton House and Chilcompton. Come and join our team to make a real difference in your community! Key Responsibilities: Be the welcoming face of our practice, greeting and checking in patients. Coordinate with doctors and staff to keep appointments running smoothly. Maintain patient records and manage appointments with precision and care. Support with vital admin tasks. Ready to make an impact? Join us and be part of a team that makes a difference every day The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the reception team may include any or all of the items listed below. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the lead receptionist or member of the management team dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels: Processing face to face and telephone enquiries and requests for appointments, visits, and telephone consultation, ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional or management or other department as appropriate. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and outside agencies. Exercise care and proper use of telephones and computer systems in normal daily working, maintaining and updating patient information in the practice appointment system. Processing personal and medical information from the patient in accordance with practice protocols, maintaining confidentiality and recording information appropriately within the clinical systems, such as triage requests, messages, updates on health status, medical information on appointments etc. Opening up/locking up of the practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols. Checks patients and visitors in when they arrive at the surgery for appointments Assist patients in the use of the self-check in screen and encourages the increased use of this method of checking in, as appropriate Pass on urgent information to doctors, nurses and other surgery staff members and also back to patients in an appropriate way Providing adhoc clerical assistance to other members of the practice team from time to time including using IT software such as Microsoft Word or finding or filing physical documents or patient files.. Handling and storing patient samples brought in at the reception desk in an appropriate way maintaining infection control standards and making sure the samples are suitably labelled with the patients details before the patient leaves. Keeping own work space, the reception area, waiting room, noticeboards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstruction and clutter. Attend and participate in any team or whole practice meetings when required. These may be on days you do not normally work, however you will be at times expected to attend and overtime will be paid. Notice for such meetings will be given in advance. Other duties as requested from time to time.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: The Crown Medical Centre is a busy GP practice in Taunton, caring for a patient population of approximately 10,000 patients. Our team includes GP partners, salaried GPs, nurses, healthcare assistants and a wider administrative and clinical team. We are looking to recruit an enthusiastic, friendly and motivated Medical Receptionist to join our reception team. The successful candidate will be one of the first points of contact for patients contacting or visiting the practice. We are looking for someone with excellent communication and customer service skills who can provide a welcoming, professional and efficient service to our patients. This is a busy and varied role, requiring someone who can remain calm under pressure, use their initiative and work effectively as part of a team. Previous GP reception experience would be desirable but is not essential, as training will be provided. The hours for this vacancy are 22 hours per week, with the following working pattern: Monday: 12:30-18:30 Tuesday:12:00-17:00 Wednesday: 12:00-17:00 Thursday:12:30-18:30 Applicants should be able to commit to these hours. However, we may be able to consider slight adjustments to the working times for the right candidate, subject to the needs of the practice. Interview arrangements: We anticipate holding interviews during the first week of December 2026. The date will be confirmed with shortlisted candidates. The main responsibilities of the role will include: Acting as the first point of contact for patients attending or contacting the practice. Answering incoming telephone calls and dealing with patient enquiries in a professional and courteous manner. Greeting patients and visitors and directing them appropriately. Booking, amending and cancelling appointments in accordance with practice procedures. Processing prescription requests and home visit requests in line with practice protocols. Passing messages and information accurately to the appropriate members of the clinical or administrative team. Dealing with patient queries and providing information about practice services and procedures. Maintaining accurate patient information and records using the practice's clinical computer system. Ensuring patient confidentiality is maintained at all times. Keeping the reception and waiting areas tidy and welcoming. Undertaking other reasonable reception and administrative duties as required. Responsible to: Reception Supervisor / Deputy Practice Manager Job purpose To provide a professional first point of contact for patients and act as a central point of communication between patients, clinicians and the wider primary healthcare team. Main duties and responsibilities Record patient arrivals on EMIS Web and direct patients to the appropriate consulting or treatment room. Use practice signposting and reception protocols to direct patients to the most appropriate service. Manage patients without appointments who require urgent advice in accordance with practice protocols, escalating concerns to a clinician or appropriate team when necessary. Process new patient registrations, check the reception email inbox daily and confirm patients reside within the practice catchment area. Explain practice arrangements and requirements to new and temporary patients, ensuring registration procedures are completed accurately. Take payments for private services and issue receipts in accordance with practice procedures, referring concerns to the secretarial team. Respond to patient and visitor enquiries professionally and promptly. Add home visit requests to the Urgent Care Team for review. Check the NHS 111 list regularly and ensure relevant patients are transferred to the Urgent Care Team for same-day GP review. Manage laboratory results received by telephone promptly and in accordance with practice protocols. Record patient signposting accurately using the appropriate EMIS Web template. Review incoming online consultation requests and process them in line with practice protocols, directing them to the appropriate clinician or service and escalating where necessary. Maintain familiarity with the appointment system, including routine and ad hoc changes. Book appointments in accordance with practice policy, seeking guidance from the Reception Supervisor when required. Ensure patient details on EMIS Web are accurate and up to date, including address, contact details and personal information. Receive and make telephone calls, transfer or divert calls appropriately, and ensure telephone systems are operational at the start of the day and switched to the out-of-hours service at the end of the day. Maintain a clean, tidy and welcoming reception and waiting area. Respond to spillages or bodily fluids in accordance with infection prevention and control procedures, including the safe use of spill kits where required. Complete a clear end-of-shift handover, communicating outstanding tasks, unresolved issues and relevant information to incoming staff. Receive and check deliveries, signing for items as required. Ensure vaccines are recorded in the appropriate log, passed promptly to the nursing team and stored correctly. Forward invoices and delivery notes to the Deputy Practice Manager. Notify relevant staff of deliveries and ensure prescription paper deliveries are reported to the Prescriptions Team for logging and secure storage. To act as a chaperone during patient consultations or examinations when required, in accordance with the practice's Chaperone Policy. The post-holder must undertake any required training and follow the practice's procedures to ensure patient dignity, privacy and confidentiality are maintained. Inform the Deputy Practice Manager of damage, faulty equipment, complaints and other issues requiring attention. Undertake other reasonable duties in accordance with the needs of the practice. Understand and maintain strict confidentiality in accordance with information governance standards. Undertake and maintain appropriate safeguarding training.
